instruction: Configure Thunderbird to connect to the main IMAP server using SSL/TLS (socket type 3) and set the timeout to 29 seconds.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Thunderbird server socket and timeout settings. Evaluator checks mail.server.server1.socketType (should be 3 for SSL/TLS) and mail.server.server1.timeout (should be 29 seconds). Verified by examining the prefs.js file which shows socketType is 3 and timeout is 29.
